definitions.explanation: The act of wagering money or valuables on games of chance. Carries a somewhat rougher, more informal tone than ギャンブル.
Figuratively, any action or decision that involves significant risk and uncertain outcome.

⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{博打|ばくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生計|せいけい}→生計：13524_seikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てていた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: He used to make a living from gambling.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {博打|ばくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (gamble, place a bet)
- {博打|ばくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (take a gamble)
- {博打|ばくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}を{出|だ}す→手を出す：22776_tewodasu⟧ (get involved in gambling)
- {大|おお}{博打|ばくち} (big gamble)

USAGE:
Also written as {博奕|ばくち}. Compared to ⟦ギャンブル→ギャンブル：10811_gyanburu⟧, {博打|ばくち} has a more traditional, rough-around-the-edges feel and often evokes images of underground or illicit gambling. The figurative sense 2 is very common in business and everyday conversation to describe risky decisions.
